feed.title: Issues of the Gulf Cybersecurity Baseline
feed.subtitle: A new issue every Monday with the six figures for the Arabian Gulf and the link to its page.

entry.title: Issue 3, 26 October 2026
entry.summary: Published on 26 October 2026, measuring 13,810 live domains in the six Arabian Gulf states.
entry.content:
1. 80.7% of the measured domains in the Arabian Gulf can be impersonated in email, because they have no enforced DMARC policy.
  2. 2.7% of the measured domains in the Arabian Gulf carry DNSSEC signatures that validate.
  3. 18.5% of the websites of the measured domains in the Arabian Gulf hold browsers to HTTPS for a year or more.
  4. 30.5% of the websites of the measured domains in the Arabian Gulf still accept TLS 1.0 or 1.1.
  5. 52.5% of the websites of the measured domains in the Arabian Gulf accept post quantum key exchange.
  6. 1.9% of the websites of the measured domains in the Arabian Gulf say how to report a vulnerability.
